Soul Exchange's mechanics work as follows:
Once Soul Exchange is successfully cast, the target loses 0.3 of their current HP%. This new HP% (Enemy HP% * 0.7) is then compared with Geist's current HP%.
If (Enemy HP% * 0.7) > (Geist HP%), the health percentages between Geist and the target enemy are directly swapped.
If (Enemy HP% * 0.7) < (Geist HP%), then 30% of the enemy's current remaining health is removed. Then, Geist receives health equal to the enemy's max health lost.
If the enemy would lose enough health to go below 30% of their max HP, it is instead set to 30%.
If the enemy was already at less than 30% of their max HP, they don't lose any HP, but Geist receives the health that the enemy would have normally lost.

The permanent bonus damage is applied after all upgrades and Spirit Scaling. Formula: ((Base dmg + Upgrade + Spirit Scaling) * stacks multiplier). I.e.: With the T2 ("+85 Damage") upgrade, stacks giving +9% damage, and 33 Spirit; Sticky Bomb will deal 245 damage ((110 [Base] + 85 [Upgrade] + 33*1.5 [Spirit Scaling]) * 1.09 [Stack Multiplier])
Permanent bonus damage stacking notes:
The game keeps track of two independent counters: hit stacks and kill stacks. These are not shown anywhere in UI.
A hit stack is gained every time a hero is hit by a bomb. A kill stack is gained whenever a hero hit by a bomb in the last 10 seconds dies.
If enemy hero dies while a bomb is attached to them, it gives one hit stack and one kill stack to Bebop. It may give additional stacks if the explosion hits/kills other heroes.
Stacking two bombs via Echo Shard gives two hit stacks and possibly one kill stack.

Whenever hit stack count reaches 60, then every hit starts giving only half of a hit stack. Likewise, when kill stack count reaches 7, every kill starts giving half of a kill stack. This also applies to stacks gained upon target death.

For calculating total damage bonus the game uses following formula: (HitStacks*(1+0.0015*SP)) + (KillStacks*(2.5+0.01*SP)) (SP = Spirit Power). The result is % damage bonus applied to the bomb and is the number shown on the UI.

Since SP determines damage for each stack and doesn't affect gaining stacks, it can be said that Spirit Power applies retroactively to already gained stacks. This can be observed by purchasing e.g. Boundless Spirit and seeing the number above ability icon increase by itself.

Damage area around Bebop,

Ava can pounce by hitting the melee key. This can break boxes and statues, but deals no damage.

Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

If the player has Confirm Cast set, they become Instant Cast while burrowed, but the visual indicators of an item's range will not appear at all.
If the player has Quick Cast set, all targeted items and Alchemical Fire cannot be used.
Mo & Krill can Slide while burrowing, allowing them to take advantage of the increased move speed on slopes.
Mo & Krill can enter Tunnel vents while burrowed, if not in combat. If Burrow goes on cooldown while inside a Tunnel, they can still exit by pressing "crouch" next to the exit.
If the player exits Burrow in a middle of a vent, they will be pushed to the side they were on before entering the vent.
If the player exits Burrow in a space too small to stand or crouch on, they will be pushed to the nearest walkable space.
Mo & Krill can still be hit by Melee Attacks while burrowed.
Mo & Krill can carry the Soul Urn while burrowed. However, they cannot enter the Tunnels while carrying it and will still drop the Urn if hit by a melee attack.
Most abilities that affect ground enemies still affect burrowed Mo & Krill: Graves' Grasping Hands, Paradox's Time Wall and others. Notable exceptions:
Abrams' Shoulder Charge does not drag Mo & Krill.
McGinnis' Spectral Wall does not block Mo & Krill's movement.

Most targeted items like Cursed Relic do not affect burrowed Mo & Krill until they "unburrow". This happens because activating an item sends out a projectile which cannot reach Mo & Krill and floats above them.
Knockdown and positive items (, etc) do not have a projectile and affect burrowed Mo & Krill normally. Notably Knockback will stun and immediately cancel the ability.
Phantom Strike still teleports a hero to burrowed Mo & Krill.
Vortex Web affects Mo & Krill if cast on the ground, and floats above them if alt-cast specifically on M&K.
If an item is targeted while being extremely close to Mo & Krill (<5m), then it will likely affect them despite the interaction. This is not stable and might be a bug.
Sand Blast launches a fast moving cylindrical projectile (similar to Silence Wave) that applies the damage and the effects when it hits enemies.

Paradox's Time Wall has inconsistent interaction with the ability. If a wall blocks the projectile completely, then Sand Blast gets properly delayed. If, however, at least some part of Sand Blast's projectile is not blocked by a wall, then the whole projectile ignores the wall.
T1 upgrade makes Sand Blast trigger Mystic Burst, which might be undesirable since otherwise the item's damage can only be triggered (and healed off of) by Scorn.
Mo & Krill can use items during Combo.
Boon scaling is not applied retroactively to existing stacks.
Upon ability use, Combo keeps momentum, most obviously shown with Majestic Leap.
If either Mo & Krill or the enemy are pulled by a Displacement effect, such as Rescue Beam or Bebop's Grapple Arm, both Mo & Krill and the enemy are displaced together.
Momentum gained from displacement effects are conserved during Combo's channel.
Knives can be used to confirm soul orbs. This will not refund a charge.
Bleed damage ticks once per second for the listed DPS, barring any outside modifiers.
While the spirit resist shred can stack, each individual stack only lasts 14 seconds (without any duration items) and its duration cannot be reset by Slice and Dice.
Bloodletting is affected by healing modifiers, which includes sources of anti-heal.
If Shiv is hit by Pocket's Affliction, and he is hit by any source of damage within the Deferred Damage Duration while at 1HP, Shiv can die to Bloodletting.
Damage dealt to barriers is not deferred.
However, if a barrier is activated after taking damage, Bloodletting will deal damage to the barrier.
Executing an enemy completely fills the Rage meter.

Shiv moves forward until either the ability's max range, or until he reaches an enemy hero below the kill threshold. Along this path, Shiv will pass through and deal the standard damage to any enemy hero that doesn't qualify for the execute, as well as Troopers and Haunts.
Shiv can also deal the standard damage to enemies behind an executed enemy if they're close enough to Killing Blow's hitbox.
When Shiv is within roughly 25m of an enemy hero that can be executed, he will see a red aura and a cracked heart symbol on that hero.
The execute deals Pure Damage.

Deals damage and reapplies its slow in 0.25s ticks.
Kudzu Connection does not require a nearby ally to cast.
Both Ivy and the tethered ally receive the bonus Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal, replicated healing, and the T1 upgrade's Move Speed buffs.
If a hero is at max health, any health they would receive is still replicated.

An active tether can be canceled by the buff-removing effects of Cursed Relic and Nullification Burst. If done while Kudzu Connection's T3 upgrade is unlocked, Ivy can immediately recast the ability when she is able to.
If Ivy has Healing Tempo, the item will constantly apply its buffs to both sides of the tether while active.
All health gained from any source other than Kudzu Connection, after applying Healing Effectiveness modifiers, will be replicated. This includes healing from Health Regen.
The Replicated Healing received is treated as having no source player, meaning it is not affected by Healing Booster or other healing modifiers.
The bonus Bullet Lifesteal is affected by healing modifiers.
Ivy has limited horizontal movement while casting.
Ivy can reload during Stone Form.
Stone Form will drag down airborne enemies near the center of its hitbox.

Stone Form can be cast while Ivy is busy, meaning it can be used during actions that would normally disable other abilities (e.g. while riding the Zipline, during the cast delay of an item, such as Phantom Strike, or during a Heavy Melee to Heavy Melee Cancel)
The casting lockout after taking damage lasts 3.5s (in the in-game HUD, this appears rounded up to 4s).
The lockout can be circumvented by carefully timing Stone Form, then casting Air Drop immediately thereafter.
Ivy can reload, cast abilities and use items while flying.
When self cast, Ivy flies solo and drops a bomb instead of a teammate. If a teammate "detaches" from Ivy during the first second of Air Drop, the ability acts as if self cast.
While flying teammates or the urn:
Allied channeled abilities (e.g. Storm Cloud) remain active, but deal reduced damage.
If Ivy or her ally are stunned in flight, Ivy's movement speed is greatly decreased for the remainder of her ult.
If Ivy or her ally are carrying the urn, Ivy's movement speed is greatly decreased until the urn-bearer is dropped, or for the remainder of her ult if carried by Ivy.
Deals 50% damage to objectives.

The "while channeling" in Last Stand's description does not refer to the duration of the ability; The Bullet Resist, Spirit Resist, and T3 Unstoppable only apply during the 2s casting period after pressing the ability key.
Majestic Leap's drop down can be used during Last Stand's channel.
Starting a charge quickly slows Yamato to 1.3m/s. This slowdown can be partially mitigated by dashing before casting or ZMC.
There are 4 stages the charging goes through. Every stage change is indicated by reticle lighting up pairs of vertical marks.
0.0s - 0.35s: initial phase where the ability can not be casted yet.
0.35s - 0.85s: "short charge" phase indicated by blue flames. Finishing here results in 30% damage.
0.85s - 1.4s: "medium charge" phase indicated by red flames. Finishing here results in 50% damage.
1.4s: "max charge" where ability automatically casts for 100% damage.
Power Slash will pierce through multiple enemy heroes.
After grappling, Yamato can go through walls and does not break connection regardless of distance or visibility.
The target can break the connection via dispel (e.g. Dispel Magic) or invincibility (e.g. Ivy's Stone Form).
Yamato can break the connection at any time during the flight by pressing the ability button (default 2) or cancel ability button (default SPACE).
Breaking connection triggers the slash animation but does no damage.
At tier 3, when the ability gets 2 charges, the time between charges is 5 seconds.
Crimson Slash has a 0.3s delay between cast and the actual hit.
Hitting multiple heroes does not heal you for more compared to only hitting one hero.
Faster ability speed results in following changes:
Power Slash: full charge time from 1.4s to 0.56s.

Flying Slash: due to several phases, some of which are not affected by casting speed, the effect is unstable. Generally it varies from being ~20% quicker for short range casts to ~30% quicker for long range casts.
Crimson Slash: cast delay from 0.3s to 0.12s.

T1 bonus weapon damage applies to each pellet in a shot. Total increase is 7 (extra dmg) * 5 (pellets/shot) = +35 damage to each shot. Alt fire has only 1 pellet. This bonus is not increased further with bonus weapon damage from items or weapon investment.
Ground Strike hits in a 120 degree wedge in front of Lash.
Ground Strike rotation is restricted to 90 degrees from the direction Lash was looking when the ability was cast.
If Lash collides with a flying enemy while doing a mid-air Ground Strike, he will drag them to the ground. This will proc the passive effect of Reactive Barrier and Indomitable.
Ground Strike can be used while on the Zipline.
Damage growth after 25m is instead 4.2 x0.008137 per meter.
At Tier 3, Ground Strike gets a bonus x0.03255 damage per meter up to 25m, and x0.008137 above 25m.
Additional uses of Grapple with the T2 upgrade will refresh the duration of the Bonus Weapon Damage buff.
Grapple can target all other heroes and any Unit.
Death Slam has a 0.4s grace time before losing focus on incomplete connections.
The landing zone impact radius is 6m and can be increased with Ability Range upgrades.
Death Slam cannot connect to enemies behind a Cosmic Veil, even from the visible side.
Splatter can hit once per bounce. Subsequent hits after the first deal 50% damage for the second, 38% damage for the third, and 26% damage for the fourth.
Affects puddle duration.
Splatter has a hidden 1.1 modifier applied to all ability duration bonuses. For example, Superior Duration gives 28% * 1.1 = 30.8% bonus to puddle duration.
The Cube does not interrupt actions and channeled abilities.
If a player starts parrying before being cubed, the parry can still block enemy Melee Attacks and stun them.
You can still be sent to Baroness Hotel by The Doorman's Hotel Guest when you are encased by The Cube.
If you are still encased by The Cube when the Baroness Hotel channel ends, you will remain encased when returned to your original position, and The Cube effect will still apply.
Players can still be targeted by abilities and items inside The Cube, but take no damage.
The Cube has reduced friction and can be pushed by melee attacks and Displacement abilities.
When casting The Cube on an ally, there is a short initial window in which they cannot leave The Cube.

When used in the air, The Cube uses the momentum of whatever surface the player most recently stood on. So if the player activates an item like Majestic Leap on a slope then uses The Cube midair, the slope momentum will transfer for incredible speed.
Base damage (non-melee scaling) is 20.
Puddle Punch only hits players, NPCs and Breakables. It does not break Bridge Powerups, Sinner's Sacrifices or the Rejuvenator.
Puddle Punch can be parried, preventing the player from being pushed and taking damage. Viscous does not get stunned if Puddle Punch is parried.
Parrying Puddle Punch procs Rebuttal.
T3 upgrade results in ~60% damage increase for the ability.
T3 enables item interactions that are specific to Heavy Melee, e.g. Melee Charge or Spirit Snatch.
T3 allows Puddle Punch to break Graves' Borrowed Decree.
Puddle Punch can push Solomon's Setup Bishop and Develop Queen.
Activating Goo Ball makes Viscous drop the Soul Urn.

Using The Cube on self during Goo Ball keeps Viscous moving in their current direction. If Viscous cancels The Cube, he immediately starts moving in the opposite direction. This does not happen if The Cube runs out of duration instead.
Damage Amp is applied on Pocket, meaning it amplifies Pocket's damage against all enemies and NPCs, even if they weren't hit by Barrage.
Damage Amp works against Sinner's Sacrifice. With max stacks, Pocket can hit jackpot with only 2 heavy melees. This is likely a bug.
Casting Barrage again before running out of stacks removes the existing stacks.
Casting Barrage and making any input that is not related to movement will cancel the Barrage without taking the cooldown.
Ground-dashing in the beginning of the Barrage animation will make the distance of the dash become significantly reduced.
T2 increases damage for each bullet in a 7-bullet spread. The total increase is 35 Damage per shot.
T2 damage buff is not affected by items or weapon investment.
Using Enchanter's Satchel disarms Pocket. Consequently, using Satchel while reloading finishes the reload instantly. Reloading while inside the Satchel will do the same thing.
Deals 50% damage to objectives.
If the debuff is currently active, applying it again refreshes the current duration.
Applying Fire Scarabs several times to a single enemy only refreshes the duration of the ability.
is not increased by Healing Amp (e.g. Healing Booster);
does get reduced by Healing Reduction;
triggers Healing Tempo's unique passive;
Mirage is Invincible when casting Dust Devil.
Djinn's Mark is considered a damage-over-time ability. Thus, the damage won't knock a hero off a zipline, and it cannot be blocked by Counterspell.

The damage scales with Mirage's Spirit Power at the moment the marks trigger, not when each stack was applied. Temporary Spirit Power changes (e.g. Infuser or Focus Lens) therefore affect all currently active stacks.
Only the initial proc of Djinn's Mark is subject to the 40m range, subsequent procs have infinite application range.

If the T3 upgrade is unlocked while marks are applied to an enemy, Mirage will be unable to increase that enemy's stacks of Djinn's Mark past 4. Attempting to add a 5th mark to the enemy will instead refresh the duration of the marks. This is likely due to a bug.
Deals a net total of 1/2/4/8/(16) times the base damage, at 1/2/3/4/(5) stacks.
The per target cooldown is affected by Cooldown Reduction.
A visual effect is generated at the target location, revealing where Mirage will appear unless Traveler is cancelled.
Using Traveler makes Mirage drop the Soul Urn.
If an enemy was selected as the target, Mirage will appear facing the target.
Cancelling Traveler before teleporting can fool enemies into wasting important abilities or fleeing from a fight, while preserving Traveler's cooldown.
Screwjab Dagger can also deal damage to Troopers and objectives.
Screwjab Dagger is blocked by the lower half of the Rejuvenator crystal.
The ability can only target Players, Neutral Camps and Structures. It cannot target Troopers and Rejuvenator crystal.
T3 also builds up with melee damage.
T3 has 4.5% build-up per bullet, affected by Damage Falloff.
When Slithering up slopes, Vyper will not lose any speed as she would on flat ground.
The T3 barrier has an 8 second cooldown before being able to be triggered again by subsequent slides, affected by cooldown reduction.
Petrifying Bola can also be used to damage Troopers, Creeps and objectives.
The bola flies in a straight line with no arc and change in speed.
The bola projectile disappears after 100 meters.
Does 50% damage to objectives.

Bolt redirect will aim accurately at enemies behind walls, provided the ability is recast while the cursor is hovering over where the target is. Targets seem to have a larger-than-normal vertical aim‑assist zone, which can cause bolts to go in weird directions on redirect.

Spectral Assistant’s teleport can be activated twice. The first activation instantly swaps Sinclair’s position with the Assistant’s. After a 2-second cooldown, a second activation can be used to swap their positions again.
The assistant cannot be cast or activated inside The Doorman's Hotel Guest.
Using the teleport while carrying the Soul Urn makes the player drop it.

The assistant's attacks use the same auto-aim mechanic that Vexing Bolt does, provided the cursor is near an enemy hero. Like with Vexing Bolt, this allows assistant attacks to fire at enemies that are behind walls or otherwise out of line-of-sight.
The ability can only target players, not NPCs.
If a hero is hexed during a heavy punch animation, parry, or a channeled ability, the action is not interrupted.
Rabbit Hex's casting delay is 0.9 seconds.
If Silver is hexed while she is under the effects of Lycan Curse, she will not transform into a rabbit. Instead, she will transform into a smaller version of her wolf form.
The Upgrade tier of Audience Participation determines the Tier level of the copied ultimate. (The copied ultimate is restricted to however many upgrade Tiers Sinclair has unlocked.)
Sinclair has a 1‑second delay before they can use the copied ultimate.
Sinclair can use Audience Participation even if the target enemy hasn't unlocked their ultimate yet.
If Spectral Assistant is active, Sinclair can use the teleport ability while copying an ultimate, except for the following:
Apollo's Itani Lo Sahn (after released)
Baba's Feed The Birds
Dynamo's Singularity
Haze's Bullet Dance
McGinnis' Heavy Barrage
Mo & Krill's Combo
Nurse Harrow's Lurking Terrors
Rem's Naptime
Seven's Storm Cloud
Victor's Shocking Reanimation
Warden's Last Stand (while channeling)
If Sinclair copies an ultimate but does not use it, Audience Participation uses its default cooldown of 85s (with the exception of Vindicta's Assassinate).

Imbuing Audience Participation exclusively affects the ultimate‑copying ability, and not the copied ultimate itself. For instance, imbuing Compress Cooldown only reduces the default cooldown after the copying duration expires, and imbuing Mystic Expansion only increases the range from which ultimates can be copied.

Sinclair only copies the properties of the ultimate, which can make it weaker compared to the original hero. For example, when copying Haze's Bullet Dance, they deal less damage due to their lower fire rate and because they do not have the Fixation passive ability.

Sinclair gets permanent bonus health from kills or assists with Mo & Krill's Combo, permanent bonus spirit power from kills with Grey Talon's Guided Owl, and bonus weapon damage from kills with Vindicta's Assassinate.

If Sinclair kills an enemy with Shiv's Killing Blow, they will gain the Killing Blow recast window, replacing the copy window. If the recast window expires, Audience Participation will go on cooldown based on Killing Blow's cooldown.

Sinclair gets Shiv's Rage passive if they copy Killing Blow, dealing bonus damage when at full Rage. The Rage lasts until Sinclair either loses Killing Blow or Rage goes down to zero. However, if Sinclair copies Killing Blow again, they will still have the remaining built-up Rage from the last copy, allowing them to reach full Rage faster.

If Sinclair copies Silver's Lycan Curse, they can transform instantly with no build-up. However, likely due to a bug, Sinclair will not gain the upgrades for two specific Silver (Transformed) abilities if their base counterparts are currently deployed: a deployed Vexing Bolt results in an un-upgraded Go For The Throat, and a deployed Spectral Assistant results in an un-upgraded Mauling Leap.
Sinclair's Audience Participation cooldown is not affected by The Doorman's Hotel Guest T3 Upgrade when someone fails to check out of the Baroness.
Troopers killed by Rake do not drop soul orbs.
The passive float lasts up to 4 seconds.
The passive float can be activated any number of times while airborne, until all 4 seconds of floating have elapsed. This resets when landing on the ground.
If Mina continues to float after the max duration has elapsed, she will accelerate towards the ground significantly faster than she would normally fall.
When using the Confirm Cast mode, only the first cast will use the range preview. Subsequent recasts will immediately activate after pressing the Ability key again.
When using the Confirm Cast mode and Alternate Cast mode as a Button, Sanguine Retreat has an undocumented alternate cast prompt. It has no effect on the ability or its visual effects.
There is no delay between Sanguine Retreats second and third recast. This is likely a bug.
Love Bites has a 10s cooldown per target.
Melee Damage does not proc Love Bites.

Non-Proc Spirit Damage dealt by Love Bites does not trigger Healbane, Mystic Regeneration, Bullet Resist Shredder, Mystic Slow, Mystic Vulnerability, Suppressor, Radiant Regeneration or Escalating Exposure.
Non-Proc Damage is increased by 50% on weakpoint hit.
Love Bites stacks build up at the following rate:
Weapon body damage: 18.4% per shot (reduced by falloff)
Headshot damage: 27.6% per shot (reduced by falloff)
Rake: 30%
Nox Nostra: 4% per bat
Deals 50% damage to objectives.
If an enemy uses Phantom Strike on Mina while she's channeling Nox Nostra, Mina keeps flying for the rest of the channel duration, then drops down under the effect of Phantom Strike.
Mina is allowed to cast Sanguine Retreat while channeling Nox Nostra.
Nox Nostra temporarily pauses the release of additional bats while Mina is teleporting.
T3 upgrade results in ~7% damage increase for the ability, as Drifter's Heavy Melee is roughly equivalent to 2.3x of his Light Melee.
T3 enables item interactions that are specific to Heavy Melee, i.e. Melee Charge or Spirit Snatch.
T3 allows Rend to break Graves' Borrowed Decree.
Mercurial Magnum will deal its bonus damage twice to enemies in close range, but Quicksilver Reload will not.
Stalker's Mark has no range limit, allowing Drifter to hit enemies across the entire map.
Damage is based on target's current health, not their max health.

Damage is divided up into 0.5s intervals, starting immediately as the projectile connects. (This works out to approximately the same overall damage per second stated in the tooltip, just dealt smoother.)
The projectile can hit Haunts, Troopers, and player-created Units.
It can hit Structures if they are not dormant, but will deal no damage to them.
Stalker's Mark can be applied to the Rejuvenator, allowing Drifter to teleport to it.
Stalker's Mark damage over time and teleport components are separate; activating the teleport does not end the bleed effect prematurely. The bleed will last the full duration either way.
If the duration expires during the cast time, Drifter will not teleport to the target.
Getting an assist on an isolated enemy hero grants the same bonuses as a kill.

The range for the movement speed near isolated heroes is 80 meters and lingers for about 7 seconds if there is no isolated target in range. 80 meters is roughly the distance between the two opposing blue guardians.
The permanent Weapon Damage per stack is additive with other increases to Drifter's Weapon Damage stat and applies to both Bullet and Melee damage.

The wording of the ability can be slightly misleading, as you have to score an assist or kill in order to gain the stack, if they are in your radius but you don't get credit for the takedown, no stack is gained.
The brief reveal of affected enemies lasts 3 seconds and can be increased by Ability Duration items. Eternal Night's base duration being increased at Tier 3 does not increase the reveal duration.

The sprint buff given to Drifter also causes him to build up to his max sprint speed significantly faster, meaning items like Trophy Collector and Shadow Weave that may normally take a while to gain speed give much more immediate effects.
Activating Eternal Night while on the ground will instantly stop all of Drifter's movement for the duration of its casting time (1s); However, momentum is preserved when the ability is cast mid-air.

When it finishes casting, Eternal Night will cause Drifter to instantly disengage from Combat, giving him his Out of Combat Health Regen and Sprint Speed regardless of how recently Drifter has damaged or been damaged by an enemy.
Eternal Night cannot proc Spellslinger as the ability causes Drifter to leave Combat before it is considered cast.
Performing a Dash Jump before casting Eternal Night mid-air will let Drifter retain some movement and land by the time the casting animation is over.
T3 upgrade does not give any extra usages, but makes Consecrating Grenade be affected by Charge-related items (e.g. Rapid Recharge).
Damage Reduction sources such as Inhibitor and Fire Scarabs do not reduce the explosion damage. However, they do reduce the lingering Pure Damage.
The grenade blows up 0.5s after bouncing.
If airborne while casting, Gutshot will push Venator away from the direction the player is facing, both horizontally and vertically.
Damage Reduction sources such as Inhibitor and Fire Scarabs do not reduce the base or wall stun damage. However, they do reduce the T3 Blessed Melee damage.
Mystic Expansion & Greater Expansion increase the distance that the target is launched.
T3 Blessed Melee notes:
It works like a blessed stake bonus, dealing bonus 115 pure damage and executing enemies below 8% health. Ira Domini's T2 upgrade also boosts blessed melee damage.
Parrying the melee prevents the bonus damage and execution.
Missing the melee does not consume the buff.
The buff lasts for 5s and is affected by Ability Duration (e.g. Superior Duration).
It deals +5 bonus damage to vampires ( Drifter, Mina, and enemies with Vampiric Burst active).
The ability can only target players, not NPCs.
Enemies can disarm the trap by shooting at it. It is not affected by abilities, items or melee attacks.
There's ~1s animation for changing weapons when Ira Domini starts and finishes. There's also ~0.8s animation for reloading stakes between each shot. Venator cannot shoot during these animations.
While Ira Domini is active Venator cannot use Consecrating Grenade but can use other abilities and items.
Low health execution checks whether the damage puts the target below the threshold, and if it does, then the ability deals additional pure damage equal to 8% of target's max health.
Ira Domini is affected by disarm.
The bolts are hitscan and can pierce through enemies.
Bolts can penetrate Kelvin's Frozen Shelter.
It deals 30% critical headshot damage.
It deals +5 bonus damage to vampires ( Drifter, Mina, and enemies with Vampiric Burst active).
Damage Reduction sources such as Inhibitor and Fire Scarabs do not reduce the base damage. However, they do reduce the bonus Pure Damage.
Ricochet and Split Shot affect Ira Domini. Split Shot fires 3 bolts total.

It takes damage equal to 40% of Victor's Max HP to gain a charge. Cooldown Reduction (e.g. Superior Cooldown) reduces the required amount to 40% × (1 − CDR%) of Max HP, with 20% CDR, you only need to lose 32% Max HP.
Jumpstart self damage is considered Pure Damage, and thus cannot be reduced by Spirit Resistance.
Jumpstart self damage is not reduced by Golden Goose Egg nor Curse.
On T3, existing non-ultimate debuffs have their duration cut in half.
If Jumpstart's buff is active before a debuff hits Victor, the duration of any debuff, ultimate or non-ultimate, will get cut in half.
Since Jumpstart's buff only reduces ultimate debuffs if it is active before the ultimate procs on Victor, it is a good idea to predict those abilities in a teamfight, such as Pocket's Affliction.
Deals damage (and applies its T1/T3 debuffs) in 0.25s intervals
Does 50% damage to objectives.

Aura of Suffering self damage is considered Pure Damage, and thus cannot be reduced by Spirit Resistance. As of now, Rat King's Ultimate aura reduces Victor's self damage, although this is likely a bug.
Aura of Suffering self damage is non-lethal (but can still trigger Shocking Reanimation).
On T3, enemies within Aura radius take +15% Damage Amp from all sources.
T3 amp also applies to all units.
Is not canceled when using Ethereal Shift.

Aura's T1 slow and T3 debuffs are continously reapplied which effectively nullifies any debuff resist. However when the player leaves the aura the effects lingers for 0.5s. which can be reduced e.g. by Debuff Reducer.
Stacking a lot of Debuff Resist can result in a situation when the T1/T3 debuffs expire before aura reapplies them every 0.25s, which results in the player continously receiving and losing debuffs.
Purges all debuffs when triggered. Victor is invincible and unable to move or act during channel.

If Aura of Suffering is active when Shocking Reanimation is triggered, it will turn itself off during the channel, then automatically reactivate itself when Victor revives. This resets Aura's damage ramp-up.
Shocking Reanimation is a passive ability, thus not affected by Silence, and cannot be imbued with items such as Mercurial Magnum and Mystic Reverb.

Attacks that trigger Shocking Reanimation will not register any deaths/kills/assists in the HUD. They will, however, trigger any and all "on hero kill" and "on assist" effects/stacks for the would-be killer and/or assistant(s).
If Victor has Cheat Death or a Rejuvenator credit, their effects are only triggered if Shocking Reanimation is on cooldown.
"Non-lethal" damage-over-time dealt by abilities like Aura of Suffering and Pocket's Affliction, or items like Blood Tribute, will kill Victor and trigger Shocking Reanimation if it is off cooldown.
If Victor winds up a heavy melee before triggering Shocking Reanimation, the melee isn't interrupted and can still damage an enemy if close enough to Victor.
Ability Range increases (e.g. Greater Expansion) affect both the radius and travel range.

If the dragon hits an obstacle, it deflects and travels along the surface until it can return to its initial course. Due to imperfections in geometry this does not always work and the direction may change erratically, especially inside small rooms.
Deals damage in 0.3s intervals.
Bookwyrm has a 0.1s. lingering effect which means it is possible to receive damage for a short time after leaving the trail.
The initial damage radius is slightly bigger than the trail width. Thus it's possible to hit an enemy with initial cast but miss applying any "trail burn" on them.
The barrier can be self-cast.
The barrier is not applied instantly: casting launches a homing projectile that applies barrier when it reaches the target.
Reapplying the barrier (e.g. via Echo Shard) does not stack over and instead refreshes value and duration.
T3 upgrade makes it so that when the barrier projectile reaches its target up to two extra projectiles launch from the target towards the nearest allied heroes.
These extra projectiles don't require Line of Sight and can pass through walls.
The search radius for allies is 30m. It is not affected by Ability Range increases (e.g. Greater Expansion)
If there are not enough ally heroes in radius to receive all extra barriers, one barrier projectile will launch towards Paige. She does not have to be inside search radius for that.
Extra shields give Weapon Damage and T1 Fire Rate.
The detonation happens 1.25s after cast.
Has half cooldown if it hits no allies or enemies.
Paige always gets the positive effects when she casts the ability.
The move speed bonus lasts for 9s.
The knights are visible as a triangle on the minimap for both allies and enemies.
If Paige is aiming upwards on cast, the knights jump on an arc.
The knight's banners don't count for their hitbox.
The bell also emits the movement slow within its radius while it's active.
A thrown bell travels 45m forward or until it hits an obstacle, whichever happens first.
Bells can be detonated by melee attacks.
T3 upgrade allows "stacking" several bells at once. This can be done for preparing high-damage bursts for the victim of Hotel Guest.
Increases bell's radius.
Does not increase bell's travel distance.
Reduces duration of both Move Slow and accuracy debuffs applied when a bell explodes.
Does not affect an unexploded Bell's slow.
Cleanses both Move Slow and debuff accuracy.
Using Dispel Magic while being inside an unexploded bell's aura will not remove slow but will heal and give other bonuses.
Dispels and protects against Move Slow.
Does not dispel or protect against the accuracy debuff.
A door can only be placed on vertical surfaces; a door cannot be placed on ceilings, floors or any slopes.
A door cannot be placed if any unit is too close to a wall where the placement is about to be. Note that casting Hotel Guest removes the player collision and may be used to overcome this restriction.
Placing a Door breaks any Golden Statues and Boxes that were close to the doorway.
Unpaired door do not have collisions. For example if a door stretches over its placement it's possible to shoot through it.
The doors' duration is indicated by a progress bar above them, and a counter above the ability button.
Doors cannot be closed for 8s after the second door is placed.
If any player enters a door while carrying the Soul Urn, the urn is dropped at the entrance door. If a player enters a door dragged by Luggage Cart, the urn is dropped at the exit door.
T3 upgrade allows making portals between the spawn room and Base Guardians. making it a powerful defensive tool as pushing an enemy into spawn is often enough to kill them outright.
Some Ability Range investment allows placing portal between the spawn room and walkers, making this maneuver easier to execute.
Luggage Cart does not stun or interrupt but applies forced movement. Enemies can still use items while being dragged.
Walkers and Base Turrets will wait until the cart expires to consider the pushed enemy as a target.
The Doorman can use Doorway to push himself with an ally cart (see Self Cart).
Luggage Cart can push enemies (and allies) through open Doorway.
Increases T3 Stun duration.
Does not increase the cart's lifetime.
Reduces duration of T3 stun.
Does not affect the card drag itself.

Players can avoid the damage by becoming invincible, such as with Ethereal Shift or Dynamo's Quantum Entanglement, or by blocking the damage with Counterspell. This works both on a successful exit (if used before the fadeout) and a failed one. However, in the latter case, it will still trigger the T3 cooldown reduction.
The target player is considered "off the map" while on the Baroness, meaning they do not share ally presence-based effects, and do not contest the Unstable Rift.
The ability has a 1s channel time before the target is sent to the Baroness. During this time:

The Doorman is only able to move very slowly and is restricted from any other action. Getting interrupted (or dying) during the channel prevents the ability from taking effect but still puts it on cooldown. The same is true if the target successfully uses Counterspell or cleanses the ability with Indomitable. The T3 Unstoppable buff is only given after a successful channel.
The target is frozen in place and cannot act, but is still vulnerable to other damage and effects. If the target dies within the channel time, the ult will not go on cooldown.

The target's channels are not cancelled during this time, and any started casts can still finish (e.g. Yamato's Power Slash). When Hotel Guest's channel finishes, the target gets interrupted and sent to the Baroness.
If the target is Ivy during Air Drop she will drop the bomb/ally immediately at the start of the channel.
When returning from the Baroness, players receive a fading Time Slow for 1s.

A target cannot activate abilities that would allow them to teleport back to the Cursed Apple from the Baroness or vice-versa, such as Pocket's Flying Cloak or Mirage's Traveler. Sinclair also cannot cast Spectral Assistant while inside the Baroness.
Applying movement slow to a target before casting Hotel Guest (e.g. Call Bell, Cold Front) makes it more likely the victim triggers extra damage and T2/T3 upgrades.
The "turning keys" animation on target's body is a good indicator to time throwing a Call Bell or launching Luggage Cart into returning victim.
Increases T2 Stun duration.
Does not affect the duration of target's stay in the hotel.
Reduces duration of a post-checkout Time Slow as well as T2 stun.
Does not affect the time in the Baroness.
Prevents Hotel Guest from teleporting target to the Baroness. The ability still goes on cooldown.

In a rare case Indomitable becomes available while already inside Baronness it will trigger on hotel checkout, preventing nothing. If the Doorman has T2 stun, it will apply to the target after the checkout since Indomitable have been already used at that point.
Being Unstoppable prevents the Doorman from casting Hotel Guest on the player.
Becoming Unstoppable while inside the Baronness can help prevent post-checkout Time Slow and T2 stun.
Bashdown has a minimum cast time of 0.3s and can be can be held down to delay starting the Slam's descent to a maximum of 1s. Holding the ability key causes Billy to rise further vertically.
Billy rises 67.5 u above his initial elevation if the ability is immediately released and up to 163.97 u while the ability key is held.
If Billy is Immobilized while using Bashdown, the ability will continuously attempt to rise, extending the cast time up to the fully held duration.

The location of the shockwave is influenced by how low Billy is looking. The more vertically down he looks, the closer it spawns to Billy; if he is looking horizontally straight or above, the shockwave spawns furthest away from him.

Billy retains his momentum when using Bashdown and has limited horizontal movement while holding the ability. If Billy reaches the max height of Bashdown, all horizontal movement becomes sharply reduced.
The max height movement lock is ignored if Billy has reduced Gravity (e.g. with Magic Carpet). It is unknown if this is intentional.
T3 upgrade results in ~29% damage increase for the ability, as Billy's Heavy Melee is roughly equivalent to 2.32x of his Light Melee.
Also enables item interactions that are specific to Heavy Melee, i.e. Melee Charge or Spirit Snatch.
Also allows Bashdown to break Graves' Borrowed Decree.
Bashdown does not deal damage to McGinnis' Spectral Wall and cannot be used to destroy it.
The ability can only target players and Neutrals, not Troopers and Objectives.

Rising Ram has a wind-up period of 0.4 seconds before charging forward. During this time, the trajectory of the charge can be changed via aiming, but adjustments become progressively more difficult as the wind-up is finishing.

Assuming Billy is in the air, Rising Ram has up to a straight angle that Billy will charge when descending (straight down) until landing; upon arrival, Billy will continue the remainder of the charge laterally, in whichever direction the model is facing. Conversely, Rising Ram only has up to approximately 50 degrees of climb when ascending, even if aiming directly upwards.

The T3 upgrade's 10% Max Health boost works differently from the Max Health granted by Blasted or Siphon Bullets. It instead scales his original health value and max health by +10%, effectively keeping him at the same percentage before and after. It is unknown if this is intentional.
Heavy Melee and Light Melee extend the duration by 4.5s and 2.8s, scaling with Ability Duration.
Light melee only grants 50% as much max health.
Hitting a heavy melee fully reloads Billy's ammo. Hitting a light melee reloads 35% of ammo, or reduces the reload time by 35% if depleted.
Bashdown procs the melee effects for Blasted.
Structures, Haunts, and summons (such as McGinnis' Mini Turret) proc Blasted's health gain and duration extension with 25% effectiveness.
The remaining duration cannot go past 35s, unaffected by Ability Duration. After reaching this limit, the duration can no longer be extended and the ability will slowly expire.
Blasted can be sustained indefinitely by spacing out melee hits before hitting the maximum duration.
Due to the fact that Blasted will work on Haunts, it is a good idea to farm them with Blasted active to be able to heal and also increase your soul count.
The heal will apply for each enemy hit, allowing for large healing if they group up together.

Casting Chain Gang will start a 2.8 second long period during which Billy sends out tethers within 12 meters. After that period concludes, all enemies with tethers remaining will be pulled within 4 meters of Billy.
The duration of this cast is unaffected by Ability Duration modifiers, such as Duration Extender, and is un-Interruptable.
As Chain Gang is not considered a channel, Billy retains full usage of his weapon, movement, and abilities during this time.
Chain Gang's tether will shatter after breaking line of sight with a hard wall or via a Cosmic Veil for at least 1 second.

However, if that enemy hero re-establishes line of sight 𝘢𝘯𝘥 is within the area of effect while Chain Gang's cast period is still active, they will become re-tethered, and will still be pulled towards Billy after the cast has concluded.
While Billy cannot innately cancel Chain Gang, entering certain inactionable states, such as using Ethereal Shift or grabbing a Zipline, will cause the ability to be canceled.
Deadheads have 20 x1.3 HP. They can be destroyed by Weapon Damage and Melee Attacks. They take no damage from abilities or items.
Deadheads yield 7 x0.5 souls when killed by players.
Each charge of Jar of Dead requires 12 "death", reducible by cooldown reduction (and rounded to the nearest integer).
Troopers and Ghouls drop 1 "death", Haunts drop 3 "death", and Heroes and Mid-Boss drop 5 "death".
Deadheads take increased damage from Monster Rounds and Cultist Sacrifice, but they cannot be consumed by Cultist Sacrifice's active.
Has 14mx0.05 range.
The ghoul deals Borrowed Decree damage, meaning T3 Borrowed Decree will also increase the ghoul's damage

The base ghoul always spawns on the midpoint between the center and left-hand end of the line. Conversely, the additional ghoul spawned after obtaining the Tier 3 Ability Point upgrade will appear on the midpoint between the center and right-hand end of the line.
When alt-cast, the base ghoul will always spawn on the midpoint between the center and the end of the line closest to Graves.
Structures are affected by spirit resist reduction, but not weapon damage reduction. The buffs are applied to Graves regardless.
The weapon damage reduction is applied as a flat reduction of the Weapon Damage stat.

Build-Up is affected by weapon damage falloff (50% at max range). Even though the ability tooltip states a "Time for Max Damage" the Build-Up is per bullet like other Build-up items and thus can be made faster by obtaining increased Fire Rate.
Graves Weapon Damage gained from this ability is additive with all her other weapon damage.
Graves Spirit Resist gained from this ability is multiplicative per instance.

The buffs Graves gains from this ability are dependent on each debuff per affected unit. If a unit affected by Essence Theft dies or otherwise loses the debuff, Graves will immediately lose the weapon damage and spirit resist she was gaining from them.
Borrowed Decree's gravestone is visible to enemies in the Minimap at all times and the outline can be seen through walls.

Ghouls will begin to follow visible enemy heroes within a line-of-sight range of 30 meters, and will continue following the enemy hero (without LOS requirement) until they are more than 30 meters away.
Ghouls will attack Haunts on sight if they are alerted. Haunts stay alerted when attacked by Ghouls. Haunts will attack Ghouls instead if they are closer than Graves.
Ghouls only use the melee attack against Troopers and Haunts.
Their melee attack deals damage in an area and can hit multiple enemies at once.
Ghouls take +48% headshot damage.
Ghouls receive additional damage from Monster Rounds and Cultist Sacrifice.
Ghouls yield 35 souls + 2 souls per minute when killed by players.
The height and lateral distance that Apollo leaps are unaffected by whether the sigil is aimed high or low when cast.
Holding a direction influences the direction Apollo launches himself (A/D biases to the left/right, W reduces the backwards motion, and S increases the backwards motion.
Recast has a cast range of 35m and can be modified by ability range.
Can target any enemy hero in range to dash to, regardless of damage source.
Can be triggered by player-generated NPCs, such as Graves' Skulls and Ghouls, McGinnis' Mini Turrets, and Troopers empowered by Rem's Lil Helpers.
Cannot be triggered normally by NPCs, including Denizens, Walkers, Guardians, and Troopers without Lil Helpers.

If a debuff is already applied to the player and then re-applied before it expires (e.g. the player is under the effect of Slowing Hex, then another enemy uses Slowing Hex on the same player) the second application cannot be blocked.
Riposte uses the same trigger rules as Counterspell. See Counterspell for more information.

In the initial cast phase of Flawless Advance, Apollo will perform a lunge in the direction he's moving towards. If Apollo has no movement input (using WASD or jumping), he will stand still in his current position. This move is not affected by inertia horizontally, but it is affected vertically: If Apollo casts while jumping or falling with no input he will lunge upwards/downwards.
Apollo must channel Itani Lo Sahn for 1.5s before he can execute the actual lunge effect.
After completing the ability channel, Apollo can continue to hold down his ability hotkey to delay executing the lunge. Apollo can delay the lunge like this indefinitely.

Enemies closer to Apollo's original cast location receive less time slow (and thereby take damage sooner); enemies farther from Apollo's original cast location receive more time slow (and thereby take damage later).

Itani Lo Sahn damage is tied to the natural expiration of the time slow debuff. If an enemy manages to dispel the time slow effect debuff prematurely (i.e. their ally uses Divine Barrier), they will take damage as soon as Divine Barrier is cast. This also means that if any enemy has a status effect that makes them immune to the effects of time slow (such as Unstoppable), they will take the damage almost instantly.
Enemies struck by Apollo are still able to parry. This allows them to block the damage with Counterspell.
Strix Salvo fires 3 rockets before its T3 upgrade.
When the ability key is pressed, the first rocket is set at Danny's crosshair. Strix Salvo can then be held for up to 1 second to aim the line before automatically shooting the missiles.
The heat gauge is visually rounded and may not show the exact amount of heat.
The jetpack creates warning beeps upon reaching 70% heat.
After overheating, the jetpack remains usable for 2.5s until the duration expires or Danny activates the dive early.
The overheat explosion resets Danny's Air-Dash and Double Jump limits.
Danny can use any number of Air-Dashes while the jetpack is not overheated. However, Air-Dashing while the ability is unlocked adds 4% heat.
Danny is able to Dash Jump mid-air by Air-Dashing then Flying. The timing is the same as dash-jumping on the ground. This triggers Arcane Surge or Kinetic Dash.
Jumping and Wall Jumping will immediately start using fuel as long as the jump button is held. Tapping quickly or binding jump to the scrollwheel can allow jumping without using fuel.
The jetpack loses -3% heat per second on the ground or on a zipline, increased to -7% with the T1 upgrade.
Danny cannot double jump unless the jetpack is on cooldown.
Danny can still fly the jetpack while sleeping as long as he is in the air; the overheat explosion does not wake him.
Various “cold” items and abilities reduce Danny’s stored heat by 10%, including:
Being hit by or using Cold Front and Arctic Blast
Being hit by an enemy Kelvin's Frost Grenade
Danny loses heat twice as quickly on the ground when inside Viscous' The Cube.
If he was already flying, Danny can continue flying inside The Cube but can only continue his current trajectory. The Cube protects him from self damage upon exploding.
If Danny is currently diving when The Cube is cast, he will explode instantly.
Danny cannot use grounded dashes while Jettison Fuel is being channeled.
Jettison Fuel's Weapon Damage can apply build-up, on-hit effects, including items that specify bullet damage.
The Weapon damage part of the ability can be blocked by Metal Skin.
Parrying while channeling Jettison Fuel will pause the ability until Danny's parry finishes.
When cast, Danny will move in a straight line to the position of the targeted enemy regardless of distance.
However, he will be stopped by obstacles and abilities such as Frozen Shelter.
While flying or falling, Danny has limited cardinal movement.
The falling damage is non-lethal to the target.
Landing hits on units counts towards cooldown reduction.
Cooldown reduction only affects Tag Along and Naptime.
Upon casting, negates falling speed and stays in the air briefly.
Rem is untargetable and immune to damage while napping.
Rem can jump to Troopers if they are followed by a Lil Helper.
The duration of Tag Along resets each time Rem hops to a new ally.
Ejecting out of Tag Along early consumes one stamina bar and launches Rem further.

The burst heal is applied as soon Rem arrives at his target, but he must continue to Tag Along in order to also apply the heal over time. Getting knocked off or hopping to another ally prematurely stops the heal early, reducing his total healing output.
Tag Along fails to successfully attach to or keep up with an ally during certain actions, such as during Mo & Krill's Burrow, or when an ally travels on a express lane.
Rem is seemingly treated as a projectile while hopping to an ally during Tag Along, as evident by the fact he is temporarily stopped by Paradox's Time Wall.
Rem can teleport along with Mirage during Traveler.
Using Tag Along makes Rem drop the Soul Urn.
Casting Tag Along does not break stealth.
Hopping to a new ally does break stealth.
Each Helper has an individual cooldown. If all Helpers were sent to follow, the ability cooldown will default to the Helper with the lowest cooldown timer.
When following a hero or trooper: The Helper's cooldown is set to the duration of said action plus the Helper's nap time. Cooldown timer is unaffected if the Helper loses their follow target.
Using Helpers for non-follow actions (crates, sinners, etc.) will apply a short ability cooldown regardless of the amount of Helpers available.
Helpers can be assigned to Sinner's Sacrifice machines, and will always secure full jackpots as if done with a heavy melee. They are interrupted if a player hits the machine.
Helpers wait until the final lightbulbs start flashing to do the last hit, allowing a short window of time for another player to get the jackpot first.
Helpers can collect Bridge Buffs.
Helpers will fully heal troopers upon cast.
Troopers with helpers yield +20% souls to enemies when killed.
Helpers following Troopers or Heroes appear as green circles on the minimap, visible to Rem and his allies.
Helpers can be assigned to a Curiosity Shop to buy items in queue. They can also buy from enemy shops, making Rem the only hero able to do so. (This does not apply to base shops.)
Rem does not need to have line of sight to the shop to send a helper to it.
Helpers have a short delay to collect souls after breaking boxes, allowing a player to collect them first.
Helpers can be attached to Solomon's Bishop and Queen, though it only increases their visual model size.
When Rem is killed, all available Helpers will fire at his killer for 1 damage.
Cooldown is halved if interrupted.
Barrier health does not count towards sleep damage threshold.
For T3 extra damage, all shots must be on the same target.
The +100% Weapon Damage vs. NPCs and the T1 +15% Weapon Damage buff while active also applies to Melee Attacks.
Using Slam Fire's +100% Weapon Damage vs. NPCs buff combined with Melee Attacks can help take Neutral camps faster
The ability can only target players and objectives.
Despite dealing Melee Damage, Boot Kick incorrectly uses the Spirit Damage icon in the ability UI. Only the bonus damage on marked target is spirit.
The target is immobilized for a short time before being kicked.
Silver can change the direction that the enemy is thrown by moving her aim after landing the kick.
Because the ability is able to immobilize enemies, it can be used to interrupt certain movement abilities, such as the following:
Vindicta's Flight.
Grey Talon's Rain of Arrows.
Abrams' Shoulder Charge.
Infernus' Flame Dash.
Wraith's Project Mind if hit just before she teleports.
Kelvin's Ice Path.
Ivy's Air Drop.
Magic Carpet's flight and while the carpet is being summoned.
Unstoppable prevents being kicked away.
Unstoppable suppresses and protects against the T3 Damage Reduction, but only for Spirit Damage.
The distance the target and Silver are pushed away after landing Boot Kick is not affected by Ability Range.
The distance the ability travels is affected by Ability Range.
The ability can only target players.
T3 Ricochet has 15m range. It prioritizes the two closest enemy players.
See Slowing Hex for a list of abilities and items silenced by Entangling Bola.
Entangling Bola can interrupt Vindicta's Flight, but cannot interrupt Grey Talon's Rain of Arrows (Interactions follow the same rules as Phantom Strike).
Entangling Bola flies forever until interrupted, it is not affected by Ability Range upgrades.
The T3's 15m ricochet range does not get increased by Ability Range upgrades.
The conditional bonus Weapon Damage of the following items does not increase the damage of the ability. This is likely a bug.
Close Quarters
Point Blank
Intensifying Magazine
Opening Rounds
Overkill damage still heals the player for the amount of damage that would have been dealt.
The ability can only target players.
Despite dealing Melee Damage, Mauling Leap incorrectly uses the Spirit Damage icon in the ability UI. Only the bonus damage over time is spirit.
The start-up of Mauling Leap can be cancelled by immediately inputting a jump command twice, without placing the ability on cooldown.
The ability can only target players.
If Silver imbues an item in one of her abilities, it is imbued in both forms (e.g. imbuing Boot Kick also affects Mauling Leap).
Once bloodlust is full, the ability can be activated to transform instantly or automatically transformed after a 3 second delay.
The player can activate the instant transform while Silenced despite the ability icon not being highlighted.
Buildup Notes:
Bloodlust passively generates 1% per second in combat and lost at the rate of -3% per second when out of combat.
Damage dealt to NPCs does not count towards Lycan Curse. However, receiving damage from NPCs does generate the passive buildup in combat.
Bloodlust builds 0.255% per damage dealt (post-mitigation by resistances).

The base required amount of hero-damage inflicted to charge Lycan Curse is 392. The damage required increases by +9.4% per Boon (additively), making it 650 at level 7 when the ultimate is unlocked, and 1682 at max level.
When below 30% health, the total damage required to charge Lycan Curse is decreased by 40% (157 damage) at level 0. This reduction increases by 4.5% per Boon (additively).
When Transformed:
Silver's weapon changes to Loose Muzzle (see "Weapon/Transformed" above for more info).
Lycan Silver has no Move Speed penalty for shooting, making Fleetfoot unnecessary to maintain full Move Speed while shooting.
Lycan Silver has 20% Crit Reduction (receives less headshot damage).
Killing enemies heals for 0 and increased by +1 per Boon. At 35 Boons, Silver gains 35 health when killing an enemy.

Lycan Curse's Fire Rate bonus has 15 maximum stacks. The +60% Fire Rate listed in the base ability is at maximum stacks, meaning Silver gains +4% Fire Rate per stack (60% / 15). "Shooting" with Loose Muzzle applies a new stack for each player or NPC hit and refreshes the duration of all previous stacks to 5s. Melee Attacks do not add or refresh stacks.
After Lycan Curse ends:
Lycan Curse's cooldown does not begin until the transformation ends.
Silver's weapon is automatically reloaded.
The Fire Rate bonus does not transfer to human form.
If Silver imbues Echo Shard on an ability, it will always use the cooldown of the human form ability, even if Silver buys the item in werewolf form.
Lycan Curse is affected by Ability Duration upgrades.
The T3 upgrade's duration refresh adds a fixed 15s duration and is not affected by Ability Duration upgrades.
Bonus damage can be detonated by melee attacks. Both light and heavy melee will trigger the full damage.
Despite the icon showing bullets on the shield, it blocks any damage.
When Shining Wonder bounces off of Dazzling Trick (T3), Dazzling Trick's duration is reset to 4 seconds.
Radiant Daggers' vertical range reaches the top and bottom of the skybox. If cast on, or inside of a building, it will hit enemy units on all vertical layers within the area of effect.
Shining Wonder can be held indefinitely and fires when the ability key or firing key is released.
Celeste has slower air glide when casting Shining Wonder in the air.
Shining Wonder can hit and bounce from Troopers and Denizens, but not Objectives. If shot at an Objective, it will phase through.
Shining Wonder's linger effect only exists for enemy heroes and the projectile will simply vanish if no viable target is found while on a trooper or Celeste herself.
If Shining Wonder hits a shrine of either team or the shopkeeper, the projectile will linger without bouncing to other targets before disappearing.
If Shining Wonder collides with Kelvin's Frozen Shelter, it will bounce off the wall before moving to targets inside the dome. Bouncing from the dome to a target counts as one bounce.
The grenade will bounce towards enemies in a range of 50.8m. This range is not affected by Ability Range.
Grenade damage is able to interact with certain conditional weapon damage.
Grenade gets bonus damage from Long Range and Sharpshooter if the enemy is further than 15m of Rat King when the grenade explodes.
Grenade gets bonus damage from Close Quarters and Point Blank if the enemy is within 15m of Rat King when the grenade explodes.
Grenade gets bonus damage from Opening Rounds if the enemy is higher than 50% health when the grenade explodes.
Grenade gets bonus damage from Intensifying Magazine.
Grenade can be punched to push it away
The ability gains a wider width by aiming with an upwards angle. This width is not affected by Ability Range.
Looking straight up when casting causes the ability to send rats behind the player.
Each bite refreshes the duration of the debuff, but the visual indicator doesn't reflect this.
Spellbreaker does not trigger during Royal Pestments.
Witchmail does not trigger during Royal Pestments.
Return Fire's Bullet Return damage stacks independently with Royal Pestments return damage, meaning you can return up to 165% of incoming Weapon Damage if both return a bullet.
Unlike other sources of Barrier, Royal Pestments mitigates Pure Damage.
Most bullet procs are blocked when reflected except:
Mirage's Djinn's Mark
Silver's Slam Fire (bonus current health damage)
Ricochet
Lucky Shot (bonus damage only)
Split Shot
Weakening Headshot / Crippling Headshot
Escalating Resilience
Hollow Point
Restorative Shot
The weapon damage of Venator's Consecrating Grenade, Gutshot and Ira Domini can be deflected.
Consecrating Grenade will still apply its burn effect.
The pure damage of Ira Domini will be blocked but not deflected back.
The weapon damage of an enemy Rat King's Scrap Grenade or Rule, Ratannia! cannot be deflected.
Metal Skin will block weapon damage from damaging the barrier. However, bullets will no longer be reflected at enemies and bullet procs of those bullets will be applied.
The player can use items during Rule, Ratannia! after the initial windup.
The player is able to jump, double jump and wall-jump during Rule, Ratannia!.
Going towards sharp slopes / ramps can send the player high upwards. This is similar to "Trimping".
The speed aura and slow aura effects are applied in a spherical area outward from the flag in all directions, even through walls.
The slam damage and knock-up effects only apply to enemies within Rat King's line of sight at the moment that he slams the flag down.
Being stunned while carrying the flag will refund the ability, allowing it to be immediately re-activated.
Multiple flags from Refresher do not stack.
Deals 50% damage to objectives.
The ability ends when recalled by Solomon, or when he dies.
Cooldown only begins when the ability ends.
On T2, if the second Bishop is not cast by the end of the 8s window, it is then automatically cast in front of Solomon's crosshair.
Square range scales with Ability Range, rounded to the nearest integer.
At base, it takes 25% ability range to reach 3, and 75% to reach 4.
At T3, it takes 16.7% to reach 4, and 50% to reach 5.
Bebop can attach Sticky Bomb to the Bishop.
Bebop's Exploding Uppercut and Viscous' Puddle Punch can push the Bishop.
Rem can attach Lil Helpers to a bishop, but Rem cannot Tag Along with the helpers. Rem deals 30% (45% at T2) of the bishop's damage as additional spell damage.
T3 self-cast only dispels debuffs that are both non-ultimate and non-stun, despite stating it removes all debuffs.
The ability ends when recalled by Solomon, after the queen's final move, or when Solomon dies.
Cooldown only begins when the ability ends.
Square range scales with Ability Range, rounded to the nearest integer.
At base, it takes 17% ability range to reach 4, and 50% to reach 5.
At T3, it takes 12.5% to reach 5, and 37.5% to reach 6.
Bebop can attach Sticky Bomb to the Queen.
Bebop's Exploding Uppercut and Viscous' Puddle Punch can push the Queen.
Rem can attach Lil Helpers to the queen, but they do not increase the queen's damage and Rem cannot Tag Along with them.
The initial attack happens 0.75 seconds after casting and deals damage in the entire area at the same time.
The second attack begins 1 second after the initial attack. The squares explode along each cardinal and diagonal line, one at a time, at a rate of 6.4 squares per second.
Both attacks apply the T2 execute.
Leeches can attach to troopers and haunts, but only leeches that were attached to heroes can be picked up by Harrow.
If an enemy hero dies while a leech is attached to them, Harrow can still pick up that leech, even if it has not "finished feeding".
Leeches eligible for pickup can be seen by Harrow from across the map and through walls, indicated by a red Leech icon.
Harrow loses the following number of leeches upon death, based on her leech stacks: 1-5 stacks (1 lost), 6-10 (2 lost), 11-13 (3 lost), 14-18 (4 lost).
Leeches spawned from a jar will despawn after 8 seconds, while leeches that Harrow can pick up will despawn after 3 minutes.
130% of damage taken during the Specter Rush is deferred as specters. The specters deal 100% of the deferred damage during the Specter Crash.
Damage from executes or a previous Specter Crash is not deferred and not amplified.
Damage dealt to barriers is not deferred and not amplified.

All healing the target receives during the Specter Rush and the Specter Crash is increased by 20% at T2. This makes it only 8.3% more difficult to heal incoming damage during the Specter Rush instead of 30%, and 20% easier to heal during the crash.
The healing of deferred damage also accounts for healing effectiveness (amp/reduction).
Ethereal Shift does not block the damage dealt by Specter Crash. Other sources of invulnerability such as Pocket's Enchanter's Satchel will block the damage.

The action speed buff/debuff seems to operate as a time slow (and time acceleration), similar to the effects of Paradox's Kinetic Carbine. This means that actions such as shooting, jumping, dashing, moving, and cast animations execute faster (or slower) than normal, while instant actions (such as parrying), cooldowns, status effect durations, and channeling durations are not affected.
The amount of charge generated by attacking depends on the type of attack landed against enemies. The amount of damage dealt does not affect the generation rate.
The amount of charge gained is increased by Ability Cooldown.
Base Charge generation rate (hits per charge):
Headshot: 2.52% (40)
Bodyshot: 1.26% (80)
Spirit damage: 1.26% (80)
AoE spirit attacks like Cold Front will count as one hit no matter how many heroes they hit at the same time.
Light melee: 7.56% (14)
Heavy melee: 15.12% (7)
Generation from damage to NPCs is 35% effective.
The heal is not affected by falloff range.
Split Shot causes Harrow to multishot healing syringes. Each ally can only be healed once per shot, and the remaining syringes will pass through them.
Hitting multiple allied heroes at once will not grant a stack of the item's damage buff.
Express Shot will fire two syringes without changing their healing.
Ricochet will cause the syringes to ricochet to nearby allies, applying 50% of the base heal.
Syringes will not ricochet back to Nurse Harrow.
Syringes can be affected by Armor Piercer, causing them to pierce through allies. The full heal will be applied to all allies hit by a piercing shot.
Restorative Shot, Burst Fire, Escalating Resilience, Headhunter, and Spiritual Overflow will proc when shooting allies.

Active Reload allows Harrow to swap to her regular gun sooner by pressing reload after reactivating the ability to put the healing syringes away, prompting the typical reload sequence complete with the Active Reload window.
Ability will only be boosted by Arcane Surge if the latter is triggered after casting the ability. It is unclear if this is intended or a bug.
Warden is immune to fear while Last Stand is active.
The T3 damage immunity upgrade blocks the specter crash damage from Wretched Vapors.
